body.statement: On finite-discrete semi-Markovian ADMGs with nonnegative finite-rational intervention costs and an all-cells full-kernel target \(Q[S_0]\), the ordinary minimum-cost intervention-design problem is NP-hard.  Under the standard set-cover threshold assumption used by the published reduction, no polynomial-time algorithm approximates it within \((1-o(1))\ln |V|\).  The reduction is cost preserving and its cover universe is represented by observed vertices.

source.locator: Theorem 2 and its set-cover reduction; the logarithmic threshold is the full-kernel hardness transfer required by the round-1 orchestrator directive
source.verbatim_statement: The ordinary full-kernel problem is NP-hard and its cost-preserving set-cover reduction transfers the standard \((1-o(1))\ln |V|\) polynomial-time inapproximability threshold.

attestation.note: The exact hardness content was supplied by the round-1 orchestrator directive; the immutable core identifies Akbari--Etesami--Kiyavash (2022), Theorem 2, as the ordinary NP-hardness carrier.
